implementation: Uncommitted C13 increment; exact runner source hashes recorded below
fault_point: SIGKILL after SQLite commit, before Spark commit, following an already committed 60-inspection prefix

timing.definition: Monotonic wall-clock interval from relaunch to observing 119 served inspections; includes process startup, state reload, replay, backlog processing and polling

fault_selector_correction: An earlier committed-prefix trial failed because update mode re-emitted a snapshot in a no-data batch. The final fault selector waits for 118 stored inspections as well as an earlier Spark commit.
limitations: One controlled Q3 driver interruption; Kafka and Q1/Q2 remain available.
Does not cover broker/disk loss, interrupted Q1/Q2 or inspection projection, or simultaneous failures.
Recovery timings are one small correctness run, not a C14 capacity or end-to-end latency benchmark.
Scores are explicitly synthetic fixture values; no model accuracy is measured.
Raw data, checkpoints, database, driver logs and full reports remain in the retained archive-data volume.
